translations.web: By this we know that we remain in him and he in us, because he has given us of his Spirit.
translations.bsb: By this we know that we remain in Him, and He in us: He has given us of His Spirit.
translations.kjv: Hereby know we that we dwell in him, and he in us, because he hath given us of his Spirit.
translations.asv: hereby we know that we abide in him and he in us, because he hath given us of his Spirit.
